'''Nok Drayen's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who was the son of [[Arak Drayen III]], the King of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]], who was overthrown and killed in [[3749 BBY]]. The son of the king went into exile and eventually had a son of his own, [[Nok Drayen]]. Before his death, he taught Nok the code required to unlock the container with the [[Crown of Dubrillion]], hidden in [[The Long Shadow]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nok Drayen's father is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Smuggler mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
